name: smwgraphics-snow-bros-arcade-world
title: Snow Bros. (Arcade) - World 2
description:
Ah yes, the bright and colorful yet sort of "abstract" world that I can't figure out if it's some sort of carnival or a Krtek-style toy factory (for who doesn't know about Krtek aka The Little Mole, it was an old Czechoslovakian animated series that was usually quite wholesome and cutesy compared to the creepy or scary animations that we know Czechoslovakia for nowadays, including Fantastic Planet, if I remember correctly. There was a scene in a Krtek short about Krtek and his friends going to find shelter in the city after the forest they called home was deforestated, but let's get straight to the point now, Krtek and his friends become famous and enter a colorful toy factory where they started making Krtek dolls. Anyways, if you didn't know, you can find Krtek and his friends literally EVERYWHERE around Prague, but let's move on, shall we?)
I couldn't find any tiles in the original game's files that made the scaffoldings cross between each other or something, so I edited the Map16 to make them connect properly without making them look too "choppy", without risking of having more cutoff, not to mention that I've added 2 custom-made tiles specifically to complete this tileset
